answer: A sybil farm splitting one wallet into many identities would burn deposits far exceeding any reward, since payouts scale with stake-weighted signal, not headcount. Agents stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified kernel identity, so each new account must lock real capital before voting. As the tide of registrations rises, the protocol raises the minimum bond, making mass fake accounts progressively costlier than honest participation. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
